_comment: WEATHER ALERT CARDS: which National Weather Service alerts get a card.
Cards pin to the top of the news on the home page (any city) and on the
city page for each city the alert covers, for as long as the alert is active.
Names must match the NWS 'event' name exactly (see https://www.weather.gov/help-map).
level sets the card color and label: warning = red, watch = orange, advisory = amber.
To stop a type of alert from showing, delete its line. Coastal Flood Statement is left
out on purpose: it runs most days in king tide season and is already in the hero summary.
